description: Side-by-side comparison of two stars: a small hot blue star and a large cool red giant, arranged left-right with labels to illustrate stellar diversity.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_Astronomy import Star

class StarComparison(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        blue = Star(
            radius=0.25,
            num_of_particles=300,
            size_of_particle=0.004,
            colors=[BLUE, WHITE],
            temperature=20000,
        ).move_to(LEFT * 2.5)
        red = Star(
            radius=0.75,
            num_of_particles=600,
            size_of_particle=0.006,
            colors=[RED, ORANGE],
            temperature=3500,
        ).move_to(RIGHT * 2.5)
        lbl_blue = Text("Blue", font_size=24, color=BLUE).next_to(blue, DOWN)
        lbl_red = Text("Red Giant", font_size=24, color=RED).next_to(red, DOWN)
        self.add(blue, red, lbl_blue, lbl_red)
        self.wait(0.5)
